title: [BUG] -- Claude Hanging and places itself in background
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [ X] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [ ] Other: <!-- specify -->
- Claude CLI version: <!-- output of `claude --version` -->
- Operating System: <!-- e.g. macOS 14.3, Windows 11, Ubuntu 22.04 -->
- Terminal:  WARP  & iTerm
- on an Intel Mac with Sequoia 15.3.2

## Bug Description
The most recent updates (for approximately the past week), are consistently hanging inside Claude Code. Pressing any key while it is "thinking" results in it being placed into a background process and when typing `fg` to put it back into the foreground, it hangs and puts out escape codes in the terminal. 

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Run Claude Code
2. Give it any longer task (>30 seconds)
3. Let it run and it hangs.

## Expected Behavior
It should not hang and place itself in background. When I use the models from cursor, windsurf or the Claude App, I do not see anything like this behavior

## Actual Behavior
Described above

## Additional Context
This is all recent behavior so it must have been introduced with the within the past week or so.
author: jeffrey-l-turner
